pr_title: GameEngine: integrate ACP external agent runtime
pr_body:
## Summary

- integrate the provider-neutral ACP core transport and AgentHost bridge
- add Claude ACP discovery, authentication diagnostics, launch metadata, and exact runtime identity
- make descriptor environment the launch authority and keep optional ACP features live-negotiated

## Integration

Codex, Goose Managed Local, AI Studio execution routing, benchmark migration, Cargo.lock, and final validation continue on this Draft integration branch.

## Validation

Dispatcher Windows Validation is required after each integration slice; the final integrated head is authoritative.
